component.name: Strife demo installer
component.summary: Strife, classic first person shooter, demo installer

description.p: Strife is Rogue Entertainment's classic first person shooter with role-playing game elements. The Strife engine is Open Source. The original Strife datafiles however are not Open Source. There is a gratis, but not Open Source demo version available on the internet.

This package contains an applications menu entry for playing Strife demo using the vavoom engine. The first time you click this menu entry, it will offer to download and install the Strife demo datafiles for you.
